model_preparation: offline data export; no Python in native execution

identity.variant: conventional four-wheel skid steering; not Mini Omni and not full-size Scout
identity.representation: Physical model: procedural box chassis and rounded ellipsoid tires; rigid suspension; functional simulation approximation. Visual model: official CAD attached with zero mass and no collisions.

source.scope: Current product page factual dimensions and mass. This page is mutable; the downloaded HTML hash identifies the audited snapshot, not an immutable URL. No vendor mesh, webpage or SDK source code is redistributed.

manufacturer_specifications.performance_claim_scope: Reference manufacturer specification, NOT an achieved simulator acceptance result

implemented_geometry.tire_inertia_principal_frame: same local frame as tire: local Z rotated to body +Y

engineering_assumptions.wheel_radius: 0.08 m estimate, consistent with 0.16 m active collision diameter in older official Gazebo wheel file and ~0.0805 m inferred from current overall length and axle distance. Current product page does not separately publish a tire radius. Not a measured effective rolling radius.
engineering_assumptions.wheel_width: 0.09 m inferred from overall width 0.58 minus track 0.49; not an independently published tire section width.
engineering_assumptions.body_shape: Single 0.612 x 0.400 x 0.130 m box; inner tire faces meet its sides. Actual shell details, bumpers and suspension arms omitted.
engineering_assumptions.mass_distribution: 19 kg homogeneous chassis box plus four 1 kg wheels. Wheel inertia is explicitly retained from the v1 solid-cylinder approximation, NOT recalculated as a uniform ellipsoid; only the tire contact/visual surface changed. Only total 23 kg is manufacturer specified; per-body mass/inertia are estimates.
engineering_assumptions.suspension: Wheel axles fixed to chassis except rotation; real independent suspension omitted. Bump traction, unloading and rollover behavior are not hardware calibrated.
engineering_assumptions.tires: Rounded rigid ellipsoids with 80/80/45 mm local semiaxes and unchanged outer envelope; not a measured tire profile. Isotropic sliding coefficient 0.8 on BOTH contact tangents; torsional friction 0.005 m, rolling friction 0.0001 m. No near-zero lateral friction, anisotropic caster shortcut, pneumatic tire model or measured force-slip curve.
engineering_assumptions.actuation: Four ideal velocity servos, kv=4 N m/(rad/s), torque bounded at +/-8 N m each; rotor dynamics, current/battery/thermal behavior and firmware not modeled. This torque is a bounded simulation estimate, not a published hardware limit.
engineering_assumptions.sensors: Massless ideal sites; device IMU is added by core. No extra physical sensor payload included.
engineering_assumptions.pose: Free body driven only by wheel contact forces; no teleport, forced base velocity or external wrench control.

control.kinematic_mapping: left=(vx-track*effective_wz/2)/radius; right=(vx+track*effective_wz/2)/radius; repeat front/rear. effective_wz = requested_wz + optional gyro yaw PI correction.
control.saturation: Joint targets uniformly scaled to max absolute 18.75 rad/s, preserving requested left/right ratio. Simulator state logs expose targets and actual joint rates.
control.lateral_command: Unsupported; Simulation rejects nonzero user vy and suppresses tracker y output.
control.body_velocity_feedback: Optional caller-provided ideal simulator feedback, separately reported. Native wheel mapping does not guarantee no-slip chassis tracking.

yaw_feedback.source: ideal MuJoCo gyro z at robot imu site
yaw_feedback.type: bounded PI yaw-rate error compensation before wheel mapping
yaw_feedback.anti_windup: Freeze yaw integral when wheel-rate saturation and its sign push farther into the bound; allow unwinding. Full zero velocity command resets the turn integral.
yaw_feedback.scope: Simulator controller, not manufacturer firmware. It drives only wheel actuators and retains the same physical friction and torque limits. The compensated wheel differential can greatly exceed no-slip kinematics; actual slip and saturation must be logged.

license_and_assets.geometry: Original procedural physical geometry and validated dynamics; separate official visual meshes, see assets/visual/scout_mini/provenance.json
license_and_assets.reference_legacy_package_license: BSD as declared by upstream package.xml; copied visual source identities recorded in assets/visual/scout_mini/provenance.json

legacy_audit.rejected_parameters: Base mass60 + four3 kg wheels =72kg; wheel_radius property .16 m, wheelbase .463951, track .416503, wheelSeparation4 in Gazebo. Not consistent with current23kg product; these dynamics and geometry are not imported.

legacy_audit.use: Reference only for active cylinder collision radius .08 m and width .084 m. Does not independently certify dimensions of current Mini revision.

version_change.change: Only tire visual/contact geometry cylinder -> rounded ellipsoid. Original mass/inertia, axles, tire envelope, friction, 8 Nm torque bound, kv4 wheel servos, gyro yaw PI and 5 ms stepping are unchanged.
version_change.rationale: Avoid sharp tire shoulders; isolated same-envelope comparison improves measured turning and first-riser engagement. This is not a claim of calibrated real tire shape.
version_change.stair_limitation: Both 4 cm and 5 cm repeated stair courses still timed out with rounded tires. This is not an obstacle-capability validation; neither rounded simulation nor the old cylinder baseline reproduces the manufacturer obstacle specification. Real suspension and tire compliance remain unmodeled.
version_change.historical_results: The native and within-spec-steps output directories describe cylinder v1. New default validation must be recorded separately as rounded v2.

identity.manufacturer: YUHESEN / Shenzhen Yuhesen Technology Co., Ltd.
identity.representation: Physical model: front Ackermann steering, two rear driven wheels; procedural geometry and rigid suspension. Visual model: official CAD attached with zero mass and no collisions.

sources.status: Official current product page; mutable URL, hash pins the read snapshot

sources.evidence: Manual printed pp.4-6: front steering/rear drive, dimensions, mass, motors, minimum radius. Printed p.17: reported/commanded steering angle is the inner front wheel, not bicycle angle. CAN tables expose separate left/right rear wheel speeds.

manufacturer_specifications.drive: front Ackermann steering, rear motor drive
manufacturer_specifications.minimum_turning_radius_reference: Not specified in manual; implementation interpretation below
manufacturer_specifications.suspension: Product page and manual table state independent suspension; manual prose also calls rear suspension a solid axle. Actual suspension geometry is not reproduced.
manufacturer_specifications.claim_scope: Reference manufacturer facts; no claim these are achieved/validated simulation limits

implemented_geometry.base_reference: Origin on rear axle centerline at chassis frame height; +X forward, +Y left, +Z up. vx/vy from base_origin therefore refer to rear axle, not geometric chassis center.
implemented_geometry.all_positive_wheel_directions: Forward along each wheel heading. Front wheel +Y hinge axes rotate with steering; rear +Y axes fixed.
implemented_geometry.site_rotations: Identity body convention before optical camera conversion; device-specific MID360 IMU added by core

engineering_assumptions.body_and_tires: Original procedural contact boxes and rounded tires, no manufacturer CAD copied. 45 mm tire width, narrow underbody, upper deck, smooth tread/shoulder are unmeasured estimates.
engineering_assumptions.suspension: All axle positions are rigid; no double-wishbone travel, pneumatic compliance, anti-roll geometry or tire force-slip calibration. Intended first-stage scope is flat, ramps and continuous hills.
engineering_assumptions.mass_distribution: 13 kg belly + 2 kg upper deck + four 0.65 kg wheels + two 0.20 kg steering knuckles = 18 kg. Only total mass is manufacturer specified. Box and cylinder-like wheel inertias are analytic estimates.
engineering_assumptions.steering: Two independent bounded position servos synthesize paired Ackermann angles. Real single steering actuator/tie-rod linkage is not mechanically reproduced. Steering axes pass through wheel centers, with no modeled scrub radius/caster/camber.
engineering_assumptions.turn_limit: Interpret published minimum radius 1.1 m as the rear axle center radius. This is an explicit convention, not an independently specified factory steering limit. Inner angle = atan(.4/(1.1-.312/2)). The ambiguous manual table entry Steering angle <=0.5 degrees is NOT treated as maximum travel.
engineering_assumptions.friction: Isotropic tire sliding friction .8 in both tangent directions; torsional .005 m and rolling .0001 m. No near-zero lateral friction shortcut.
engineering_assumptions.rear_motor_servo: kv=4 N m per rad/s, each torque bounded +/-4 N m. Angular speed capped by 6.5 km/h / .07 m. Values other than nominal rated power/top speed are simulator estimates; not motor current curves/firmware.
engineering_assumptions.steering_servo: kp40 N m/rad, kv2 N m per rad/s, each bounded +/-3 N m, limited to derived inner angle. Simulation actuator approximation, not real single65W linkage dynamics.
engineering_assumptions.sensors: Ideal massless sites. No payload, bias/noise or firmware replay; sensor pipeline provides separate provenance.

control.command_reference: rear axle centerline; moving yaw command is converted into curvature wz/vx
control.validation: Reject any nonzero vy; reject nonzero wz when abs(vx)<=1e-9. Finite moving commands above steering curvature are limited and explicitly logged.
control.ackermann: delta_left=atan(L*k/(1-track*k/2)), delta_right=atan(L*k/(1+track*k/2)); signed k=wz/vx handles reverse. Rear speeds=(vx-wz*track/2)/radius and (vx+wz*track/2)/radius.
control.front_rolling: Passive hinges. target_velocity first two entries are no-slip predictions for telemetry, never actuator commands.
control.actuator_indices_contract: actuator_indices and drive_actuator_indices contain ONLY rear_left/rear_right velocity actuators. steering_actuator_indices separately contain front_left/front_right position actuators. wheel states and targets remain FL/FR/RL/RR.
control.stop: Zero motor-speed command and centered steering; braking arises only from bounded rear wheel servo torque. No free-body velocity/force/pose writes.
control.feedback: No body velocity or gyro feedback inside FrMiniController. Optional caller body tracker is reported separately; caller suppresses lateral output and bounds yaw by abs(vx)*max_curvature before controller.

assets_and_license.geometry: Original procedural primitives from factual public dimensions; no downloaded CAD/mesh/model code redistributed.
assets_and_license.manual: Read for factual configuration only, not copied into repository.
assets_and_license.sdk_lookup: Official download page links FR-mini-ros and FR-mini-ros2; GitHub API returned404 during this audit. Model does not depend on these unavailable endpoints.

license_and_assets.geometry: Original procedural physical geometry and validated dynamics; separate official visual meshes, see assets/visual/fr_mini/provenance.json

identity.representation: Physical model: Procedural collision-driven base with four hub motors and forty passive roller hinges. Visual model: official CAD attached with zero mass and no collisions.

manufacturer_specifications.scope: Published hardware specifications, not simulator achievements

control.saturation: All hub targets uniformly scaled to the max absolute wheel rate; passive rollers have no actuator
control.scope: Original simulator wheel servo, not Clearpath firmware. Command limits are conservative implementation bounds, not manufacturer limits.

engineering_assumptions.mass: 135 kg follows current product page. Pinned URDF chassis165.304 + rockers2*10.267 + wheels4*2.5 =195.838 kg contradicts that page; upstream masses are not blindly combined. This model uses123kg centralbody+2kg deck+4*(1.5kg hub+10*.1kg rollers).
engineering_assumptions.inertia: Primitive-derived mass distributions/inertias, not measured hardware tensors. Only total mass and upstream nominal 2.5kg wheel mass are reference values.
engineering_assumptions.rollers: Ten freely hinged ellipsoid barrel rollers per wheel. Count and profile are engineering approximations, not measured Clearpath CAD. Roller envelope may overlap internally; robot self-collisions are disabled, environment collisions remain fully physical. Radial envelope varies slightly with wheel phase.
engineering_assumptions.contact: All wheel rollers use isotropic sliding friction .8 in both tangents, condim3. No mu2=0 Gazebo shortcut. Small passive-bearing viscous damping .00001 Nm/(rad/s) and hub damping .02 are estimates.
engineering_assumptions.hub: Physical hub radius .038m stays off flat ground; normal rolling contact is carried by the passive rollers.
engineering_assumptions.suspension: Axles rigidly attached; pinned ROS2 rocker joints are fixed, and no real suspension compliance is reproduced.
engineering_assumptions.chassis: Narrow central collision box plus full-width elevated deck approximate wheel wells. No vendor mesh is copied; shell details omitted.
engineering_assumptions.motor: kv8 velocity servo and +/-20Nm bound are estimates, not published motor/current limits; battery/thermal/firmware dynamics omitted.
engineering_assumptions.sensors: IMU mount uses pinned offset transformed to the central-box base origin; ideal massless LiDAR/camera mounts are project placements, not vendor hardware.
engineering_assumptions.physics: Free base, no pose or velocity assignment and no external body force in control; wheel-floor contact is the only source of chassis actuation.

license_and_assets.geometry: Original procedural physical geometry and validated dynamics; separate official visual meshes, see assets/visual/ridgeback/provenance.json

identity.variant: four independently steered and driven conventional wheels; not Mini V1/V2, full-size Ranger or mecanum
identity.representation: Physical model: procedural two-box chassis, four steering modules and rounded rigid ellipsoid tires; no suspension. Visual model: official CAD attached with zero mass and no collisions.

source.scope: Current Mini 3.0 product page factual specifications. Mutable page snapshot identified by hash; no manufacturer assets or code copied.

manufacturer_specifications.suspension: four-wheel independent suspension, omitted from this first-stage rigid model
manufacturer_specifications.performance_claim_scope: Manufacturer reference only, not achieved simulator acceptance results

engineering_assumptions.shell: Overall shell dimensions are not published on the audited current product page. Estimated narrow lower keel and wider upper deck form a collision union that clears each steering tire sweep; not a manufacturer CAD reconstruction. Both chassis and chassis_deck must count for body-contact evaluation.
engineering_assumptions.wheel_radius_and_width: 110 mm radius and 70 mm width are explicit geometric estimates, not a Mini 3.0 measured rolling radius. Steering changes the wheel envelope.
engineering_assumptions.steering_axis: Zero caster/trail/scrub offset, vertical through each hub. Actual hardware offsets are not published in the audited sources.
engineering_assumptions.mass_distribution: Only total 73 kg is sourced: estimated 44 kg homogeneous keel + 15 kg deck + four 1 kg steering bodies + four 2.5 kg uniform ellipsoid wheels. Steering-body diagonal inertia [.0015,.0015,.001] kg m2; no measured COM/inertia.
engineering_assumptions.suspension: Rigid steering pivots relative to chassis; native independent suspension and compliance not implemented. Uneven-ground load sharing is not calibrated hardware behavior.
engineering_assumptions.tires: Rigid rounded ellipsoids with isotropic sliding friction .8 on both tangents, torsional .005 m, rolling .0001 m; no anisotropic lateral-slip shortcut or tire deformation.
engineering_assumptions.steering_limits: Estimated mechanical range +/-pi rad and commanded joint speed cap2 rad/s. Actual joint speed may transiently overshoot because torque is finite. Neither range nor speed is claimed as a hardware specification.
engineering_assumptions.actuation: Drive velocity servos kv6 N m/(rad/s), +/-20 N m each. Steering bounded velocity-feedback torque +/-20 N m, angle-to-rate gain8/s, rate gain12 N m/(rad/s). These finite simulator values are estimates, not inferred from motor power. No power/current/thermal model.
engineering_assumptions.sensors: Massless ideal sites; shared core adds the MID360 device IMU. No extra sensor payload mass.
engineering_assumptions.pose: Free body advances only through gravity and real joint/contact forces; no body wrench, pose or base-velocity writes.

control.command_limit_scope: Conservative initial simulator envelope; lower than manufacturer 2m/s. Shared Simulation validates body commands.
control.kinematic_mapping: At module(x,y): ux=vx-wz*y, uy=vy+wz*x. Choose azimuth atan2(uy,ux) or equivalent +/-pi with reversed wheel rate, minimizing actual steering rotation within mechanical bounds.
control.alignment: Hold every drive target at zero until all nonzero-speed module heading errors are <=.10rad; steering uses real bounded torque. Zero-speed modules hold current azimuth.
control.saturation: Uniformly scale all requested wheel rates to max abs13.63636rad/s. Alignment hold is logged separately from saturation.
control.stop: Full zero command latches current actual azimuth once and sets all drive targets to zero. Finite-torque physical brakes; no pose freeze, no endless steering to an obsolete target.
control.native_feedback: Joint position/velocity feedback only. Optional outer chassis tracker belongs to shared core and must be reported separately.
control.firmware_scope: General swerve simulation, not exact AgileX CAN mode behavior. Official ROS2 Mini v3 selects parallel for nonzero vy and does not retain simultaneous wz there; this simulator explicitly permits coupled vx/vy/wz.

official_software_audit.confirmed: Explicit RangerMiniV3Params, ranger_mini_v3 launch and SDK Variant selection. Driver package has no Mini3 geometry/mesh asset.
official_software_audit.conflicts_not_silently_imported: V3 ROS parameters use track .364m and max linear1.5m/s; current Mini3 product page says .370m and2m/s. Use current product geometry, and a separately declared lower simulator envelope. V1 .36m wheelbase is not used.

official_software_audit.confirmed: kRangerMiniV3 maps to RangerMiniV3Base; SetMotionMode and SetMotionCommand are distinct hardware calls.

license_and_assets.geometry: Original procedural physical geometry and validated dynamics; separate official visual meshes, see assets/visual/ranger_mini/provenance.json

control.description: Existing two-wheel velocity mapping; no outer command tracker.

adaptation.description: Official ROBOTIS URDF dynamics and mesh geometry converted offline to MJCF; no runtime Python or ROS dependency.
adaptation.inertia_source: URDF values, including its simplified fixed caster/LDS inertias; not measured hardware identification.
adaptation.caster_model: Original fixed box support contacts retained with low sliding friction; not free-spinning caster dynamics.
adaptation.actuation: MuJoCo ideal wheel velocity servos: kv=1.0 N m s/rad, force limit=1 N m; simulator parameters, not a measured XL430 motor model.
adaptation.track_note: Official URDF wheel centers give 0.288 m; official driver YAML uses a nominal calibrated 0.287 m. Geometry and controller values are preserved separately.
adaptation.sensor_mounts: Existing simple_rbt MID360/camera selectable sites, rigid MID360 assembly; native LDS mesh retained as robot visual/collision geometry.
adaptation.integration: MuJoCo implicitfast at 1 ms for the original small wheel inertias and a stable ideal wheel velocity servo; not a measured motor/electronics dynamics model.
